description: Jobs — Apply to a job for the user: Worklittle fills out and submits the application in a browser. Pass job_id from search_jobs. For a Worklittle-hosted posting also include name, email and resume. It submits by default; pass auto_submit false when the user wants to review first, then show them the answers from check_application_status and send it with submit_application only after they say so.

applicant.description: With use_profile false: the person applying. name and email are required; phone, city, state, country, work_authorization, needs_sponsorship, desired_salary, about_you are recommended. Send their resume as resume_text or resume_pdf_base64.

about_you.description: Standing answers: notice period, sponsorship, referrals, anything else.

needs_sponsorship.description: true if they need visa sponsorship to work

applicant_id.description: With use_profile false: the person from an earlier apply. Store it permanently with the person and reuse it; it works with any Worklittle API key. It is also emailed to them; if lost, ask them for it.

auto_submit.description: Default true: submit when the form is complete. false: stop at review (status awaiting_submit) so the user can check every answer; send it with submit_application.

confirm_same_company.description: Only after the person agrees: apply even though they already applied to 3+ jobs at this company in the last 30 days (the call paused with CONFIRM_SAME_COMPANY).

cover_letter_html.description: Optional cover letter HTML to seed.

job_id.description: Worklittle job id from search_jobs / get_job_details.

job_ids.description: Apply to up to 10 jobs in one call (instead of job_id), all for the same person and with the same options. Returns one result per job.

resume_id.description: Use this one of the user's saved resumes. Leave out to let Worklittle pick the best one for the job.

resume_pdf_base64.description: With use_profile false: the applicant's resume PDF, base64.

resume_text.description: With use_profile false: the applicant's resume as plain text.

tailor_resume.description: Default from apply settings (on): write a resume tailored to this job. false: send the resume as is.

test.description: true: a free practice run. Nothing opens, nothing is stored or sent to an employer, no personal information needed. The session moves queued → running → completed over ~25 seconds.

use_profile.description: Default true: apply as the signed-in user with their profile. false: apply as the applicant described below (another person, no Worklittle account needed).

name: apply_for_job

outputSchema.description: JSON result from this Worklittle MCP tool.
